tests.name: createProposal mints a proposal and bumps the nonce (owner 0 of a 2-of-3 treasury)
createProposal by owner 2 sets owner 2’s approval bit
createProposal on a 1-of-1 treasury mints an already-Approved proposal
createProposal REJECTS proposerIndex == ownerCount (out of range)
createProposal REJECTS a negative proposerIndex (which would alias owner 0)
createProposal REJECTS owner 0’s signature presented as owner 1
createProposal REJECTS a garbage signature
createProposal REJECTS amount 0
createProposal REJECTS maxFee above maxProposalFee

SECURITY createProposal REJECTS a vault template that does not hash to the pinned vaultTemplateHash — an attacker-chosen template would let the minted proposal commit its bond return to an attacker-chosen address

SECURITY createProposal REJECTS minting a proposal whose vaultSpkHash is not the one this lineage derives — the bond can be root-reserve-funded, so a proposer-chosen return address drains the reserve 0.5 KAS a proposal
createProposal REJECTS an unknown operation code
createProposal REJECTS a root continuation that does not bump the nonce (proposal id replay)
createProposal REJECTS a root continuation that rewrites the owner set
createProposal REJECTS a minted proposal whose snapshot threshold is lowered
createProposal REJECTS a minted proposal that starts with two approvals
createProposal REJECTS a minted proposal that starts Approved on a 2-of-3 treasury
createProposal REJECTS a minted proposal that pre-loads a rejection bit

createProposal REJECTS an UNBOUND root input (zero covenant id) [weak control: it fails at the right guard on the real contract, but cannot flip on a stripped mutant — deleting any line changes KoRoot’s redeem script and therefore its P2SH address, so the real signature this fixture carries stops verifying]

createProposal REJECTS minting a THIRD output under the treasury lineage (forged sibling) [weak control: it fails at the right guard on the real contract, but cannot flip on a stripped mutant — deleting any line changes KoRoot’s redeem script and therefore its P2SH address, so the real signature this fixture carries stops verifying]

createProposal REJECTS letting a forged sibling — not the minted proposal — inherit the lineage [weak control: it fails at the right guard on the real contract, but cannot flip on a stripped mutant — deleting any line changes KoRoot’s redeem script and therefore its P2SH address, so the real signature this fixture carries stops verifying]

createProposal REJECTS dropping the covenant binding from the root continuation [weak control: it fails at the right guard on the real contract, but cannot flip on a stripped mutant — deleting any line changes KoRoot’s redeem script and therefore its P2SH address, so the real signature this fixture carries stops verifying]
createProposal REJECTS a genesis treasury with ownerCount 6 (the constructor’s bounds are enforced here — index 5 would otherwise fall through to owner 0’s key AND owner 0’s bitmap bit)
createProposal REJECTS an ownerCount-6 genesis treasury before it authenticates anyone (owner 1’s signature at index 5 trips the same bound, not checkSig)
createProposal REJECTS an ownerCount-6 genesis treasury even when the mint claims a sixth bitmap bit (there is no sixth bit; the bound trips first)
createProposal REJECTS proposerIndex 5 on a well-formed 5-owner treasury (proposerIndex < ownerCount; the ownerCount-6 genesis that used to reach ownerAt’s fall-through is now rejected outright)

createProposal REJECTS a genesis treasury with threshold 0 (the constructor’s bounds are enforced here — `threshold <= 1` would otherwise mint every proposal already Approved, one key moving funds under a nominal M-of-N)
createProposal REJECTS an ownerCount-0 genesis treasury (bricked at require(ownerCount >= 1), before proposerIndex is even range-checked)
createProposal REJECTS a genesis treasury whose owner slots 0 and 1 hold the SAME key (one key, two approval bits — a 1-of-2 treasury labelled 2-of-3)
createProposal REJECTS a duplicate in a NON-ADJACENT live pair (slots 0 and 2 — every pair below ownerCount is compared, not just neighbours)
createProposal REJECTS a duplicate in the LAST live pair of a full 5-owner treasury (slots 3 and 4)
createProposal ACCEPTS the NUMS-padded tail of a 2-of-2 treasury (slots 2..4 share one key by construction, and are never compared)
createProposal ACCEPTS a duplicate BEYOND ownerCount (slots 2..4 repeat owner 0’s key, but proposerIndex < ownerCount can never select them, so they carry no bit and no vote)

createProposal REJECTS shrinking the root continuation and the minted proposal to dust and paying the reserve elsewhere (KIP-9 storage mass makes every later covenant op expensive — a single owner could price the treasury out of use)
createProposal REJECTS a dust root continuation even when the minted proposal keeps its value (the floor is over the PAIR, so neither can be starved alone)
createProposal accepts spending exactly maxProposalFee across the two id-bearing outputs (the floor is a cap on leakage, not a demand that value be preserved)
createProposal REJECTS spending one sompi more than maxProposalFee across the two id-bearing outputs
createProposal accepts TWO bound root UTXOs when the id-bearing outputs cover the whole set (the rule permits a legitimate multi-UTXO spend rather than banning it)
createProposal REJECTS outputs that cover only ONE of two bound root UTXOs — a per-input floor would have let the second root’s whole reserve walk out on one honest proposal
createProposal REJECTS the same one-of-two spend from the SECOND root input’s point of view too (every copy of the script must agree)
createProposal REJECTS a 17-input spend that parks a second root UTXO past the scan window (the loop’s own bound rejects the transaction outright, so the sum can never be incomplete)
createProposal accepts a 16-input spend (one under the scan window — the ceiling the proposer’s own fee UTXOs now share with the root)
bootstrapVault mints the vault stamped with the root’s own lineage, leaving the root state untouched
SECURITY bootstrapVault REJECTS stamping the vault with a lineage that is not this root’s (the stamp IS the treasury; a vault built around any other id belongs to whoever chose it)

SECURITY bootstrapVault REJECTS a template that is not the vault (the spender supplies the bytes, so only the baked hash keeps them honest — otherwise the root mints an arbitrary script into its own lineage)
bootstrapVault REJECTS a non-owner’s signature
bootstrapVault REJECTS owner 0’s signature presented as owner 1
bootstrapVault REJECTS ownerIndex == ownerCount (out of range)
SECURITY bootstrapVault REJECTS altering the root while bootstrapping (a bump here would desynchronise the nonce from the proposals it names)
SECURITY bootstrapVault REJECTS rotating the owner set while bootstrapping
bootstrapVault REJECTS draining the root reserve below the fee cap
SECURITY bootstrapVault REJECTS minting a third output under the treasury lineage
SECURITY bootstrapVault REJECTS an UNBOUND root (a plain payment to the root address is exactly that, and it carries no lineage to stamp)
executeConfig installs the approved new owner set and threshold, keeping the nonce
executeConfig REJECTS a proposal that is not Approved
executeConfig REJECTS a TRANSFER proposal (operation 1) as a config change
executeConfig REJECTS a revealed config that does not match the committed hash
executeConfig REJECTS newOwnerCount 6 (above the five owner slots the state carries)
executeConfig REJECTS newOwnerCount 0
executeConfig REJECTS newThreshold 0
executeConfig REJECTS newThreshold greater than newOwnerCount
executeConfig REJECTS a continuation that installs a different owner set than the one revealed
executeConfig REJECTS a continuation that resets the proposal nonce
executeConfig REJECTS draining the root reserve beyond maxProposalFee
executeConfig accepts spending exactly maxProposalFee from the root reserve
executeConfig accepts merging TWO bound root UTXOs into one continuation that covers the whole set
executeConfig REJECTS a continuation that covers only ONE of two bound root UTXOs (the second root’s reserve would walk out on one honest config change)
executeConfig REJECTS a proposal input whose revealed script is not the pinned template
SECURITY executeConfig REJECTS an UNBOUND root input paired with an UNBOUND proposal (both ZERO ids compare equal)
SECURITY executeConfig REJECTS a proposal from a FOREIGN covenant lineage
SECURITY executeConfig REJECTS a STALE config whose snapshot THRESHOLD differs from the current root config (rotation replay)
SECURITY executeConfig REJECTS a STALE config whose snapshot OWNER differs from the current root config (a removed owner reinstating themselves)
SECURITY executeConfig REJECTS minting a second output under the treasury lineage
SECURITY executeConfig REJECTS continuing the lineage onto an output other than the root continuation
executeConfig REJECTS installing a set whose slots 0 and 1 hold the same key (the honest path would otherwise reach exactly the state the genesis check rejects)
executeConfig REJECTS a duplicate in a non-adjacent live pair of the installed set (slots 1 and 3)
executeConfig installs a 2-of-2 whose slots 2..4 are the shared NUMS pad (unused slots are not compared — otherwise no treasury could shrink below five owners)
executeConfig installs a set whose duplicates all sit BEYOND newOwnerCount (dead slots carry no bit and no vote)
